row.team_price_text: Foundations: $400/mo (up to 100 employees, monthly; 10% off annual)
row.evidence: Ashby's pricing table marks SCIM Directory Sync as not included on Foundations and included on Plus and Enterprise (both Get in Touch); the help centre says "SCIM can be configured for accounts on the Legacy Plus, Plus, and Enterprise plans."
row.notes: Status unchanged (gated). Plans renamed since June: Foundations / Plus / Enterprise (docs also mention Legacy Plus); the June 'Growth' name is gone, so scim_plan is now Plus. Foundations is priced by company size (up to 100 employees), shown as $400/month with 10% off annual; Plus and Enterprise are quote-only. SAML/OIDC SSO is a $100/month add-on on Foundations and included on Plus and Enterprise. SCIM is delivered through WorkOS via a setup link from Ashby support; it syncs hourly, deactivates users missing from the directory, and does not map roles (users arrive as Limited Access). The Okta OIN Ashby app is SAML/OIDC only, so Okta provisioning runs through the WorkOS SCIM connection. The June note's $30K-$70K/yr figure had no first-party source and was dropped. The public API (all plans) can list and read users but not create or deactivate them.

plans.name: Foundations
plans.notes: Priced by company size, not per seat. SAML/OIDC SSO available as a $100/month add-on.

auth.token_source: Setup link from Ashby support (WorkOS-hosted onboarding)

operations.notes: Ops inferred from Ashby's description (provisions and deactivates, syncs field updates); HTTP-level operations are WorkOS's and not documented by Ashby. 'Groups' is listed as a syncable field.

deprovision.data_retained: User record is kept in a deactivated state and is reactivated when reassigned in the IdP.

custom.how: Cost Center, Department and Division are stored as Ashby Employee custom fields

attributes.notes: Ashby lists syncable fields as Job Title, Name Updates, Cost Center, Department, Division, Groups, Manager (toggled under Admin > Integrations > SCIM); SCIM attribute names are not given and the enterprise-extension mapping is inferred.

roles.how: Not supported; provisioned users get Limited Access and are re-permissioned in Ashby

rate_limits.text: Syncs run hourly; Ashby also responds to webhooks.

limitations.text: SCIM runs through WorkOS and is set up from a link sent by Ashby support, not self-serve.
Enabling Directory Sync deactivates every Ashby user not present in the directory.
Okta reassignment fails with 'user already exists' unless the Okta app username format is Email.
No role or permission mapping via SCIM.

user_api.notes: RPC-style JSON API: every method is POST https://api.ashbyhq.com/<method>.

endpoints.purpose: List users (active by default; includeDeactivated for all), paginated with syncToken
Set a custom field value on an employee

webhooks_user_events.notes: The webhook list on the API reference covers applications, candidates, interviews, jobs, offers and openings; no user events were seen.

audit_log_api.notes: auditLog.list exists but is in closed beta with early design partners.

limitations.text: User endpoints are read-only for identity: no create, invite, deactivate or role-assignment method is documented.
User global roles (Organization Admin, Elevated Access, Limited Access, External Recruiter) are returned but not settable via a documented method.

okta.notes: OIN page checks SAML and OIDC only (SCIM and provisioning capabilities unchecked, read from page markup). Ashby's help centre still describes Okta provisioning through the WorkOS SCIM connection.

entra.notes: No Entra gallery tutorial found; Ashby lists Microsoft Azure AD as supported through WorkOS.

google.notes: Ashby lists Google Workspace as supported through WorkOS; whether that covers provisioning is not stated.

open_questions: Ashby does not document the SCIM endpoint, version, token or HTTP operations itself; they sit with WorkOS.
Whether SCIM deactivation frees the seat or ends sessions is not documented (pricing is by company size, not seats).
Whether SSO must be set up before SCIM is not stated.
No Entra gallery, OneLogin or JumpCloud catalogue app was confirmed.
Foundations price varies by company size; $400/month is the default shown and the per-size prices are not in the page text.
API rate limits are not documented in the reference index.
Whether SCIM 'Groups' sync maps to Ashby groups or teams is not explained.
